name: Disabling Security Tools
author: GAI_CTI
query: (Image:*\/service AND (CommandLine:*iptables* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/service AND (CommandLine:*ip6tables* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/chkconfig AND (CommandLine:*iptables* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/chkconfig AND (CommandLine:*ip6tables* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*firewalld* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*firewalld* AND CommandLine:*disable*)) OR (Image:*\/service AND (CommandLine:*cbdaemon* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/chkconfig AND (CommandLine:*cbdaemon* AND CommandLine:*off*)) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*cbdaemon* AND CommandLine:*stop*)) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*cbdaemon* AND CommandLine:*disable*)) OR (Image:*\/setenforce AND CommandLine:*0*) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*stop* AND CommandLine:*falcon\-sensor*)) OR (Image:*\/systemctl AND (CommandLine:*disable* AND CommandLine:*falcon\-sensor*))
